participation.context: Named the three prices, and left Holinshed where it lies.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Heard his kin were safe, and kept his book off the road.
participation.name: Richard Field

participation.context: Cleared the table for the parcels, and allowed no third errand.
participation.name: Jacqueline Field

story.body: You showed the shoes, the fables and the pins, said the horse was dear, and did not take the book.

title: Showed Field the shoes, the fables and the pins

participation.context: Sorted the parcels, and left Holinshed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Found the chipped H, and said it had been in Plutarch.
participation.name: Richard Field

participation.context: Gave the bread and the hard cheese, and asked for one thanks.
participation.name: Jacqueline Field

story.body: You accepted the first day's food and a broken letter for the boy, and you still did not take the book.

title: Took the cheese and the chipped H

participation.context: Wrote the three lines and closed the book.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set the morning's three prices on the tables and left them unadded.

participation.context: Came from Field's stair and stayed for the prayer.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the feast and withheld the street.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

story.body: You stood for St James and did not trade news at the door.
